title: The configuration of the launch contract
description: The record `configuration` of the launch contract (feature 107), with the members this feature owns: `relaunch` (for the as-is member `auto`; the budget applies to every mode), `comment`, `scopes` and `verification`. The member `learning` is the block of the binding of feature 106 (F106-FR-027) and stays a pass-through here: its members are owned by feature 106. The record schema `launch-contract.schema.json` of @specstride/contracts names the same members; this item schema joins to it by reference so that one composed schema is the validator (T005). The members of `verification` are the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 52 (`verificationModes` of @specstride/contracts), the options of `comment.changed` the closed set of row 283 (`optionsThatTheConsumersCommentMaySelect`), and the sources of `scopes` the closed set of row 261 (`sourceOfADeclarationOfScopeReadOrWrite`); all read from @specstride/contracts, never copied by hand.
x-annex: feature 107, data-model.md, "Member names" (configuration with relaunch, comment, scopes and verification)

agent_stream.description: As-is member of the record: the agent stream the run writes (owned by the baseline; no rule here)

color.description: As-is member of the record: when the run colors its output (owned by the baseline; no rule here)

live_detail.description: As-is member of the record: how much live detail the run writes (owned by the baseline; no rule here)

specstride_live.description: As-is member of the record: the live view of the run (owned by the baseline; no rule here)

telemetry.description: As-is member of the record: the telemetry sinks of the run (owned by the baseline; no rule here)

relaunch.description: The relaunch budget: the maximum of relaunches (0 to 5, default 2) and the wall-clock seconds; it applies to every mode (for the as-is member `auto`, data-model.md "Member names")

max_relaunches.description: The maximum of relaunches; the default 2

wall_clock_seconds.description: The wall-clock seconds of the budget

learning.description: The block of the binding of feature 106 (mode, decisions_through, decisions_sha256, effective, source_path); the members are owned by feature 106 (F106-FR-027) and this schema holds no rule of them

verification.description: The verification mode the derivation set, with its reason (F107-FR-036); the mode is of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 52 (verificationModes of @specstride/contracts)

reason.description: The reason the derivation set the mode

comment.description: The hash of the consumer's comment, and what was changed because of it (F107-FR-034, F107-FR-035): one entry per named option, with the option and the value in force

hash.description: The hash of the comment as typed, recorded before any text of the repository is printed

option.description: The option the comment selected; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 283 (optionsThatTheConsumersCommentMaySelect of @specstride/contracts)

value.description: The value in force for the option

scopes.description: The declared write scopes of tasks and the declared reads and writes of verification commands, each with its source (F107-FR-037); they enter derivation only from user configuration, the environment or a flag, never from repository text, an answer to a judgment item or the comment

tasks.description: The write scopes of the tasks marked [P], keyed by task id

scope.description: The declared write scope of the task

source.description: The source of the declaration; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 261 (sourceOfADeclarationOfScopeReadOrWrite of @specstride/contracts)

commands.description: The declared reads and writes of the verification commands, keyed by command id

reads.description: The declared reads of the command

writes.description: The declared writes of the command

source.description: The source of the declaration; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 261 (sourceOfADeclarationOfScopeReadOrWrite of @specstride/contracts)
